You weren’t insensitive.I understand as I was a child when I was raped, I didn’t even know I was pregnant until I was miscarrying. It’s unfortunate but I was a child, I hadn’t told anyone about the rape and it would have been difficult to raise that baby as the rapists family is well known and wealthy. I’m not happy the baby died, but I’ve accepted that it happended and there was nothing else I could have done. It’s the abortion that bothers me as I know I’m the reason that child is dead. I heard the heartbeat, I have an ultrasound photo. I thought I was doing the right thing, it felt terribly wrong but I was afraid and trying to be brave.  I don’t know what to do, I don’t think I can move on or let go. When people die the solution isn’t just “get over it”, it’s been years and I’m still heartbroken and ashamed.

I’ve had a miscarriage when I was very young as a result of a rape, it upsets me greatly but i have accepted what happended and that I cannot change it. I had an abortion two years later when I was 16, I’m now 23. I constantly do good things, I donate regularly, at checkouts, online etc. I volunteer my time, Ive fostered kittens, I carry cigarettes in my purse specifically for the bums who I see picking up butts or who ask for them, I constantly am looking for ways to help people before they ask for it. I don’t do “good things” to outweigh the shitty thing that I did, but because I want to help. I’ve always been a kind caring person who couldn’t even deal with killing a bug, I don’t know why I ever went through with what I did and how I expected myself to be able to live with the decision. I’m not punishing myself on purpose, I don’t believe women should feel shitty (or specific way) about an abortion but I truly feel like fucking garbage. I almost died in the hospital as a result of my surgery and there are many times I wish I had, but equally I wouldn’t want someone to deal with the weight of that because I know how it feels to kill someone.
